channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US House votes to end Iran war, 7 Republicans join in favour
item.description: For a third time, the US House approved a war powers resolution, halting Trump's ability to continue military action.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi drone headed for Mecca
item.description: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted a drone before it entered Islam's holiest city, calling pilgrims' security a 'red line'

item.title: Iran war increasing inflation, straining US munitions: congressional report
item.description: Report by nonpartisan research body finds that replenishing depleted munitions stockpiles could take up to five years.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi coalition intercepts, destroys drone headed for Mecca
item.description: Saudi Arabia has intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone that was heading toward Mecca.

item.title: Panic on board Iranian plane as violent shaking rips cabin apart
item.description: A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 cabin rips apart after an emergency landing in Mashhad, Iran.

item.title: Republican congressman calls to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
item.description: GOP Representative Thomas Massie has emerged as outspoken critic of war on Iran and overseas military interventions.

item.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
item.description: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

item.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
item.description: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

item.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
item.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
